market_view.rationale: Relentless foreign institutional net buying exceeding ₹23,500 crore across three sessions continues to drive heavy outperformance in frontline benchmarks and Nifty Bank (+2.49%), overriding weak underlying breadth where only 40% of stocks trade above their 50-day average. A rising INDIA VIX to 17.32 and small-cap weakness (-0.13%) signal high selectivity, favoring large-cap liquid leaders over broader market momentum.

sector_pick.name: NIFTY PSU BANK
sector_pick.rationale: Maintains undisputed relative strength leadership with a 19.66% one-month return, continuing to absorb aggressive foreign institutional liquidity.

last_week_review: Last week's bullish lean on large-cap financial leaders held up exceptionally well as massive FII liquidity sustained the surge in frontline indices and PSU banks.
